overview_description.description:
Cyborg Network is building the next generation of AI infrastructure by deploying high-performance edge AI hardware into real-world environments. Our mission is to power real-time, privacy-first AI applications such as autonomous mobility, smart surveillance, industrial robotics, and intelligent city infrastructure. Unlike traditional cloud-based approaches, Cyborg Network offers low-latency AI inference through a decentralized network of edge compute devices called Cyborg Miners, that are remotely managed, SLA-bound, and auditable.

We enable governments and enterprises to run compliant, secure AI workloads at the edge, without relying on crypto-based payment systems. Our system is interoperable with cloud partners like AWS and Azure, and we are also building out compliance-first integrations with blockchain networks.

Cyborg Network has been supported by grants and partnerships from Nvidia Inception, Qatar government initiatives, and the Web3 Foundation. Our goal is to become the go-to infrastructure layer for real-time AI in the physical world.
